```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(klaR)
data <- read_csv("../data/processed/full_data_cleaned.csv")
```
## Clustering 

```{r}
features <- c(
  "age","race","gender","education","urbanicity","income","political_belief", "past_hesitancy","vaccine_doses"
)
cluster_data <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(features)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
cluster_data <- cluster_data %>% drop_na()

set.seed(123)
cost_df <- data.frame(k = 1:6, cost = rep(NA, 6))

for (i in 1:6) {
  kmodes_result <- kmodes(cluster_data, modes = i, iter.max = 10)
  cost_df$cost[i] <- kmodes_result$withindiff
}

# Plot elbow curve to decide optimal number for clusters
elbow_plot <- ggplot(cost_df, aes(x = k, y = cost)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Elbow Method for Optimal k",
       x = "Number of Clusters",
       y = "Within-Cluster Distance") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:6) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(
  filename = "../output/figures/elbow_plot.png",
  plot = elbow_plot,
  device = "png",
  width = 10,       
  height = 8,      
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,       
  bg = "white"    
)

```

```{r}
k <- 3
kmodes_result <- kmodes(cluster_data, modes = k, iter.max = 50)
data_cluster <- data %>% 
  mutate(cluster = factor(paste("Cluster", kmodes_result$cluster)))

tryCatch({
  kmodes_result <- kmodes(cluster_data, modes = k, iter.max = 50)

  data$cluster <- factor(paste("Cluster", kmodes_result$cluster))

}, error = function(e) {
  message("Standard k-modes failed. Trying modified approach...")

  cluster_data_reduced <- cluster_data %>%
    select(age, gender, education, past_hesitancy, vaccine_doses)

  kmodes_result <- kmodes(cluster_data_reduced, modes = k, iter.max = 50)
  data$cluster <<- factor(paste("Cluster", kmodes_result$cluster))
})

cluster_profiles <- data %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    top_age = names(which.max(table(age))),
    top_education = names(which.max(table(education))),
    pct_additional = mean(additional_doses == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    emotion_response = mean(ad_group == "Emotion" & additional_doses == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    reason_response = mean(ad_group == "Reason" & additional_doses == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Compare ad effectiveness by cluster
effectiveness_cluster <- data %>%
  filter(ad_group %in% c("Emotion", "Reason")) %>%
  group_by(cluster, ad_group) %>%
  summarize(response_rate = mean(additional_doses == "Yes")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cluster, y = response_rate, fill = ad_group)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Ad Effectiveness by Cluster")

ggsave(
  filename = "../output/figures/effectiveness_cluster.png",
  plot = effectiveness_cluster,
  device = "png",
  width = 10,       
  height = 8,      
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,       
  bg = "white"    
)
```

```{r}
#Cluster summary statistics 
cluster_summary <- data_cluster %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    pct = round(n/nrow(data_cluster), 3),
    across(all_of(features), 
           ~ paste(names(sort(table(.), decreasing = TRUE)[1:2]), collapse = "/")),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cluster_summary <- cluster_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Clustering Summary Statistics**")
  ) %>% 
    tab_options(
    table.width = px(1000),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    table.font.size = "50%"
  )

tryCatch({
  gtsave(cluster_summary, 
         filename = "../output/tables/cluster_summary.png",
         vwidth = 1000,
         vheight = 600,
         zoom = 2)
}, error = function(e) {
  # Fallback method if gtsave fails
  html_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".html")
  gt::gtsave(cluster_summary, html_file)
  webshot2::webshot(html_file, 
                   "../output/tables/cluster_summary.png",
                   selector = "table",
                   vwidth = 1000)
})
```

## Regression 

*Method*: 

One key question I would like to explore is if the ad effectiveness varies among clusters. To furter investigate this question, I ran a regession on additional doses using cluster as independent varible. 

*Finding* 

There is no significant interactions, indicating that ad effectiveness does not differ by identified clusters. 

```{r}
data_cr <- data %>%
  mutate(additional_doses_num = as.numeric(additional_doses == "Yes"))

model_cluster <- glm(
  additional_doses_num ~ cluster * ad_group,
  data = data_cr,
  family = binomial
)

output_file <- here::here("output", "tables", "clustering * regression_results.html")

stargazer(model_cluster,
          type = "html",
          out = output_file,
          title = "Ad effectiveness by clusters",
          covariate.labels = c(
            "Cluster 2", "Cluster 3", "Emotion","Reason",
            "Cluster 2 * Emotion", "Cluster 3 * Emotion", 
            "Cluster 2 * Reason", "Cluster 3 * Reason", 
            "Constant"
          ),
          model.numbers = FALSE
          )

```
